The '''Kingdom of Albion''' was a predecessor or rival state in the Solaran homeland during the [[Solaran War of Unification]].

== Defeat In 1538 ==

Old source material says the [[Grand Duchy of Solan]] and the [[Kingdom of Congrave]] defeated Albion after seven years of conflict. That defeat allowed the coalition to found [[Solara]] in early 1538.

The source does not say whether Albion was annexed, federated into the new state, stripped of its monarchy, or given regional autonomy. This draft therefore treats Albion only as a defeated predecessor state until more canon confirms the settlement.

== Legacy ==

Albion's defeat became part of Solara's founding memory. The modern state's unity was built not only from agreement between Solan and Congrave, but also from the incorporation of a defeated rival.
